# Security policy

DotReticulum.Ecosystem is an experimental project written predominantly by LLM coding agents under human direction. It is **not** audited and must not be used for production or security-critical purposes.

## Reporting a vulnerability

Please report suspected vulnerabilities privately through GitHub's "Report a vulnerability" feature on the Security tab of this repository. Do not open public issues for undisclosed vulnerabilities, and do not include real private keys, captured private traffic, or credentials in any report.

Expect a best-effort acknowledgement; there is no support SLA.

## Scope

Issues in the Reticulum stack that this project builds on should be reported to the [DotReticulum](https://github.com/dennispayne/DotReticulum) repository; issues in upstream Reticulum, LXMF and the other upstream projects should be reported to their maintainers.
